fr_html: La discussion porte sur la détermination de la situation respective des particuliers et de l'Etat qui prend fait et cause pour eux devant la Cour de Justice.
en_html: The debate bore upon the definition of the respective positions of private individuals and States which took up cases on their behalf before the Court of Justice.
